breachMonitor.title: Breach Monitor
breachMonitor.subtitle: Monitor your accounts for known security breaches.
breachMonitor.description: Monitor your vault credentials against the local offline HIBP dataset.
breachMonitor.daemonDesc: Checks every vault password against the local offline HIBP filter. Passwords never leave your device.
breachMonitor.onlineDesc: Using the HIBP k-anonymity API — only the first 5 characters of your password hash are sent. Your passwords never leave your device in plaintext.
breachMonitor.offlineMode: Vault daemon offline — scanning via the HIBP public API (k-anonymity). Connect the daemon for fully offline scanning.
breachMonitor.filterMissing: HIBP filter not installed — run hibp/build-filter.sh then reload the daemon to enable breach lookups.
breachMonitor.noCredentials: No credentials with passwords to scan.
breachMonitor.offlineFilterDesc: 900 M+ breached passwords stored in an 8 GB Cuckoo filter, queried entirely on-device.
breachMonitor.compromisedDesc: Your digital identity has been detected in 3 major database breaches. Immediate action is required to rotate credentials and secure your assets.
breachMonitor.actionRequired: Action required for the following accounts
breachMonitor.deepScanDesc: Perform a manual exhaustive search across 12B+ records.
breachMonitor.zeroKnowledgeDesc: PWDnow utilizes industry-leading APIs combined with our proprietary dark-web scraping engine. We employ k-Anonymity and zero-knowledge principles—your raw passwords and email addresses never leave your device unencrypted.
breachMonitor.realtimeDetectionDesc: Immediate notification the moment your data appears in a new leak.
breachMonitor.hashedComparisonsDesc: We only monitor anonymized hashes to ensure your privacy is absolute.

settings.title: Security Configuration

settings.confirmUpdateDesc: Are you sure you want to commit some updates? If lost you may lose your access.

settings.setup2FADesc: Enhance your account security by adding an extra layer of protection.
settings.setupAuthenticatorDesc: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Authy, Google Authenticator) to generate time-based codes.
settings.setupSecurityKeyDesc: Insert your physical security key into your device's USB port or use NFC to register it.
settings.setupEmailAuthDesc: We will send a verification code to your registered email address to confirm your identity.
settings.emailSetupSuccess: Email verification has been successfully configured.
settings.codeSent: We have sent a message. Enter the 6 digit code at:
settings.auditLogDesc: View every access attempt and configuration change.
settings.recoveryKitDesc: Essential for account recovery if master password is lost.
settings.emergencyAccessDesc: Designate trusted contacts to access your vault in emergencies.
settings.twoFactorDesc: Recommended for all users to prevent unauthorized access.
settings.authAppDesc: TOTP codes via Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.
settings.authAppDesc2: Use apps like Authy or Google Authenticator for time-based codes.
settings.securityKeyDesc: Physical YubiKey or Titan security key for hardware-level protection.
settings.emailVerificationDesc: Receive temporary codes via your registered email address.
settings.emailServerDesc: Configure your outgoing mail server for password resets and notifications. Supports SMTP, ESMTP, STARTTLS and SSL/TLS.
settings.description: Manage your account settings, security preferences, and active sessions.
settings.autoLockDesc: Automatically sign you out after a period of inactivity to protect your vault.
settings.themeDesc: Choose how PWDnow looks to you. Select a theme or sync with your system.
settings.samePasswordError: New password must be different from your current password.
settings.weakPasswordError: New password must be at least 12 characters.
settings.sessionExpired: Session expired. Please log in again.
settings.passwordUpdateFailed: Failed to update password. Please try again.
settings.passkeyDesc: Synced passkey via iCloud Keychain or Google Password Manager. Works across your devices.

settings.passwordlessEnabledDesc: Password field is hidden at login. Sign in using your configured MFA method.
settings.passwordlessDisabledDesc: You have 2+ authentication methods. Disable the password field at login and sign in with your biometric or security key instead.
settings.httpsRequired: Passkeys and biometrics require HTTPS or localhost. This feature is unavailable on plain HTTP.
settings.webAuthnUnsupported: WebAuthn is not supported in this browser.
settings.biometricUnsupported: Platform biometrics are not supported in this browser.
settings.passkeyCreatedDesc: "{{name}}" is saved. You can now use Touch ID or your passkey provider to sign in.
settings.biometricCreatedDesc: "{{name}}" can now be used to sign in on this device.
settings.exportVaultDesc: Download a copy of your credentials
settings.exportWarning: Exports are unencrypted. Store the file securely and delete it after use.
settings.importVaultDesc: Bring in credentials from another manager
settings.importDropzone: Drop file or click to browse
settings.importReplaceWarning: This will permanently delete all {{count}} existing credential(s) before importing. This cannot be undone.
settings.travelModeDesc: Hide selected folders behind a separate travel password.
settings.travelActiveDesc: {{count}} folder(s) hidden — vault appears sanitized. Hidden data is AES-256-GCM encrypted locally and invisible to device inspection.
settings.travelInactiveDesc: Hide designated vault folders when crossing borders or entering high-risk environments. Hidden data is encrypted on-device with your travel password — invisible to inspection, fully restorable with the travel password.
settings.travelStep1Desc: Select which folders to hide when Travel Mode is active. These folders will be AES-256-GCM encrypted and invisible until you disable Travel Mode with your travel password.
settings.travelNoFolders: No folders found. Create folders in your vault first.
settings.travelPasswordDesc: This password is required to restore hidden folders. It is separate from your main vault password and is used only to decrypt the hidden vault.
settings.travelSelectAtLeastOne: Select at least one folder to hide.
settings.travelWarningDesc: If you forget it, the hidden folders cannot be recovered — they are encrypted with your password. There is no backdoor.
settings.travelActivateConfirmDesc: Hidden folders are encrypted and invisible. Your vault has been updated.
settings.travelDisableDesc: Enter your travel password to decrypt and restore {{count}} hidden folder(s).
settings.duressModeDesc: Trigger a forensic wipe after too many failed login attempts.
settings.duressArmedDesc: Entering the duress password at login triggers an immediate forensic wipe. Auto-wipe after {{max}} failed attempt(s) ({{remaining}} remaining).
settings.duressDisarmedDesc: A separate duress password entered at login silently wipes all vault data (3-pass CSPRNG overwrite). Also auto-triggers after a configurable number of failed login attempts.
settings.duressArmedConfirmDesc: Entering the duress password at login will trigger an immediate forensic wipe. Auto-wipe activates after {{count}} failed attempt(s).
settings.duressStep1Desc: Set a duress password — different from your main password. Entering it at login triggers an immediate forensic wipe of all vault data.
settings.duressStep2Desc: Confirm your duress password. This cannot be recovered.
settings.duressWipeWarning: Triggering wipe performs a 3-pass CSPRNG overwrite of all localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, and Cache Storage. This is irreversible.
settings.duressPasswordMinError: Duress password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.forensicWipeDesc: Permanently destroy all vault data on this device.
